rows.name: Reflection
rows.description: Reflection is an American AI research lab advancing open-source AI through open-weight models, shared research, and tools for developers. Its platform gives developers and enterprises API access to its models, alongside the freedom to inspect, customize, and deploy them on their own infrastructure

rows.name: TypeSafe AI
rows.description: TypeSafe AI builds AI models for automated decision-making in software. Its System One Models return typed decisions with calibrated confidence estimates, helping developers build workflows that account for uncertainty. Teams control when software acts autonomously and when it requests human review, making AI automation easier to integrate and manage.

rows.name: Wafer
rows.description: Fast open source LLMs for enterprise

rows.name: NVIDIA
rows.description: NVIDIA Build is a developer platform for discovering, testing, and deploying leading AI models and ready-to-use blueprints. With hosted APIs and optimized NVIDIA NIM microservices, it accelerates the journey from prototype to production across cloud, data center, and local GPU infrastructure.
